column3: Close to the Hebrew; The plural form “creators” is rendered “Creator,” and “until that not” as “before.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Keepers” is rendered “watchmen,” and “the grinders cease” as “the grinding ones stand idle.”
Close to the Hebrew; “They may be reduced” is rendered “will sing softly.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Fail” is rendered “is ineffective,” and “his house of perpetuity” as “his eternal home.”
NASB adds “Remember Him” at the start; the Hebrew continues the sentence with “before.”
Close to the Hebrew; “He weighed” is rendered “he pondered.”
Close to the Hebrew; “And what was written [in] uprightness” is rendered “and to write … correctly.”
“One shepherd” is rendered with a capital, “one Shepherd,” and the order of the comparisons is adjusted (“masters of these collections are like well-driven nails”).
Close to the Hebrew; “Study much” is rendered “excessive devotion to books,” and “flesh” as “the body.”
Close to the Hebrew; “This [is] all humankind” is rendered “this applies to every person.”
